title: Revolution of the Lances
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Revolution of the Lances", at revision 1370707036, opens: "The Revolution of the Lances occurred in Uruguay from September 12, 1870 to April 6, 1872." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7318719, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "civil War in Uruguay (1870-1872)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
